declaring_sources.provenance_record: schemas/plugin-release-provenance.schema.json, built and validated through the canonical epistemic_foundry.release.provenance runtime (composed, not reimplemented)

bundle_clean_extracts.mechanism: zip_integrity_test builds a deterministic ZIP_STORED bundle from the in-repo payload and proves it clean-extracts byte-identically into a temp root, refusing absolute, parent-traversal, backslash and drive-colon members before extraction and refusing content-tampered or surplus members

signatures_and_provenance_verify.mechanism: signature_test derives the signing status from the signatures actually present (fail-closed UNSIGNED and not-shippable for the reference bundle) and refuses any SIGNED over-claim, while the provenance record is built by the canonical runtime and validated against plugin-release-provenance.schema.json with every embedded digest re-derivable

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: parallel agent; reviewer: primary session; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
